problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks across 10 different distribution centers.

Each truck follows a predetermined route represented as pairs (Distribution Center, Handling time), where each pair specifies the center where the truck must be processed and the time required for handling. The sequence of pairs indicates the strict order in which the truck must visit the centers.

Truck details:
* T1 follows the route: (DC2, 7) → (DC5, 7) → (DC8, 10) → (DC7, 9) → (DC3, 5) → (DC10, 10) → (DC4, 8) → (DC9, 7) → (DC6, 4) → (DC1, 3)
* T2 follows the route: (DC8, 2) → (DC5, 6) → (DC3, 2) → (DC1, 1) → (DC9, 4) → (DC2, 2) → (DC6, 10) → (DC4, 6) → (DC10, 9) → (DC7, 1)
* T3 follows the route: (DC5, 1) → (DC8, 1) → (DC7, 1) → (DC1, 4) → (DC2, 2) → (DC3, 1) → (DC6, 8) → (DC9, 2) → (DC4, 5) → (DC10, 4)
* T4 follows the route: (DC9, 1) → (DC6, 9) → (DC7, 10) → (DC2, 10) → (DC8, 7) → (DC5, 10) → (DC10, 8) → (DC4, 3) → (DC3, 7) → (DC1, 10)
* T5 follows the route: (DC9, 6) → (DC10, 10) → (DC2, 7) → (DC8, 7) → (DC5, 5) → (DC7, 4) → (DC3, 7) → (DC4, 7) → (DC1, 10) → (DC6, 7)
* T6 follows the route: (DC9, 6) → (DC4, 6) → (DC8, 8) → (DC1, 10) → (DC7, 5) → (DC5, 10) → (DC10, 9) → (DC3, 2) → (DC6, 1) → (DC2, 2)
* T7 follows the route: (DC5, 5) → (DC3, 7) → (DC10, 5) → (DC6, 2) → (DC2, 9) → (DC1, 10) → (DC8, 1) → (DC9, 1) → (DC4, 3) → (DC7, 4)
* T8 follows the route: (DC2, 8) → (DC7, 10) → (DC3, 2) → (DC6, 9) → (DC5, 4) → (DC9, 9) → (DC8, 8) → (DC1, 3) → (DC4, 8) → (DC10, 10)
* T9 follows the route: (DC6, 8) → (DC4, 10) → (DC3, 3) → (DC1, 7) → (DC8, 1) → (DC9, 9) → (DC7, 1) → (DC2, 9) → (DC5, 4) → (DC10, 9)
* T10 follows the route: (DC10, 6) → (DC6, 4) → (DC1, 2) → (DC7, 7) → (DC2, 4) → (DC8, 3) → (DC5, 4) → (DC4, 8) → (DC3, 10) → (DC9, 7)

Each handling procedure must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each distribution center can only handle one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all trucks at the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all trucks is minimized.
